scope.completion_rule: A merged UI or closed issue is not acceptance without the owner contract, exact pin and required native/provider/cross-repository evidence.

C-JSON.command: find catalog conformance contract-artifact docs/evidence integration orchestration quality schemas workflows -type f -name '*.json' -print0 | xargs -0 -r -n1 jq --exit-status 'true'
C-JSON.meaning: Strict JSON parsing; no semantic or native claim.

C-CI.meaning: Existing workflow-v1 catalog and synthetic fixture gate.

C-CHECKSUMS.command: sha256sum --strict --check SHA256SUMS (for each context contract artifact)
C-CHECKSUMS.meaning: Copied schema, conformance and manifest bytes match their checked-in digests.

C-MATRIX.command: CI matrix step: context SHA256SUMS checks, 22-row/21-child/43-issue assertions, and source-lock artifact digest loop
C-MATRIX.meaning: The acceptance record is structurally complete and its locked bytes are checked without promoting external gates.

C-PIN-AUDIT.command: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number} and gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/commits/main
C-PIN-AUDIT.meaning: Exact heads, merge commits and issue states were read from GitHub; this is not runtime acceptance.

C-PROCESS.command: cargo run --manifest-path tools/conformance-driver/Cargo.toml -- --binary <pinned-sts2-harness-build> --catalog workflows/sts2 --capabilities catalog/capabilities/synthetic-full.json --missing-capabilities catalog/capabilities/synthetic-missing-map.json --negative workflows/sts2/map.strict.json
C-PROCESS.meaning: The historical candidate run passed and is cited in EXECUTION_REPORT.md; no owner binary was rebuilt for this documentation-only change.

C-OWNER.command: Owner repository locked fmt, policy, clippy, test and browser/managed-source commands named by each companion PR
C-OWNER.meaning: Owner CI is evidence only when the owner PR and its exact revision are merged; no cross-repository suite was rerun here.

C-NATIVE.command: Separately authorized native host/game/provider acceptance command
C-NATIVE.meaning: No game launch, profile mutation, deployment, provider call or host restart occurred.

owner_dispositions.reason: This matrix, refreshed artifacts and evidence are the workflow-owned delivery for issue #11.
Harness owns the interpreter, scheduler, live ports and backend contracts; this repository only copies pinned artifacts and fixtures.
Studio owns UI and authoring behavior; no duplicate UI implementation is added here. Owner CI for PR #126 passed, while aggregate cross-repository acceptance remains separate.
Gateway owns process authority and save-profile forwarding; PR #53 is a source/component save-profile slice and PR #54 is an open lifecycle slice. No route or host operation is copied here.
MCP owns bounded tool mapping; no tool server is copied here.
Game-mod owns profile/native admission. PRs #118, #123 and #125 are source-only safety slices; PR #113 is a source-only native probe and issue #79 remains open_unverified for acceptance.
Context Console owns retained context reads/controls and provider-session delegation; PRs #20 and #21 are open component slices, while workflow publishes metadata-only contracts.
Only a pinned evidence-qualified rules reference was audited; no workflow-owned schema, catalog or conformance promise changed.
Protocol remains the canonical owner; this delivery adds no protocol fields or transport implementation.
